resolved_build_failure: The first dependent compile found that rspice-simulation did not handle the existing Allocation variant or the new DeviceResourceLimit variant. The adapter repair preserves both through service and worker contracts, and the final dependent check passes.

final_selected_core_unit_outcome.explanation: 564 successful cases in the broad run plus its one repaired case passing in the final four-test run; overlapping focused cases are not added again.

delivered_contracts: Shared DelayAcceptanceError distinguishes validation, record-policy refusal with requested/allowed counts, and allocator failure with its source.
One retention calculation counts the complete ordinary or sided/known-order candidate before commit. Pruning releases records without discarding required interpolation history.

Native GP startup, step preparation and physical-event validation preserve typed errors. DeviceResourceLimit carries the elaborated instance and TransportHistoryRecords metadata; its public descriptor is nonretryable resource_limit.
Tests exercise ordinary, unknown-order and known-order records at the real per-site ceiling; a later failing BJT leaves earlier participants unchanged.

Public checkpoint resume from a valid constant-bias history at the ceiling preserves the caller image, hierarchical identity and numeric metadata, then the same engine resumes its original checkpoint identically.
Service/worker errors preserve device counts and allocator details; optimization stops after the first resource refusal. Existing worker enum variants retain their order.
unchanged_contracts: The fixed 1048576-record per-site ceiling, aggregate transport-byte quota, equations, event clocks, tolerances and checkpoint encoding are unchanged.
Oversized/malformed checkpoint data remains validation failure, not a runtime resource-limit event.
open_evidence: C03c still requires reconciliation of the intended configuration/target and parameter/topology matrix, measured cancellation latency, and repeatable memory/performance evidence.
Runtime VM transactions and their error/admission adapters remain C09 work; this native GP delivery does not qualify all external-model execution.
Other model state, trial caches, solver allocations and full parser/control/result integration remain C01/C09/C12/C14 work.
All C00-C14 packages remain open; these selected checks do not establish whole-core production readiness.
retention: Ignored raw logs remain local. Commands, hashes, scoped outcomes and exact committed source are retained. Test durations are not performance measurements.
